final: WITH city_counts AS (SELECT c.location, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM qualifying q JOIN races r ON r.raceId = q.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId GROUP BY c.location), overall AS (SELECT AVG(record_count) AS avg_count FROM city_counts), kept AS (SELECT cc.record_count, cc.record_count - o.avg_count AS difference FROM city_counts cc CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE cc.record_count > o.avg_count) SELECT AVG(record_count), AVG(difference) FROM kept
